name: html-runtime-textarea-editor-shell
description: Preserves a runtime-bound textarea editor surface with save and preview controls as one bounded HTML island without requiring an app-root class.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral editor surface recognized from runtime-bound textarea, save control, and preview target rather than source naming.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <section><textarea id="draft" aria-label="Draft"></textarea><button id="save" type="submit">Save draft</button><output id="preview"></output></section>

expect.value: <section><textarea id="draft" aria-label="Draft"></textarea><button id="save" type="submit">Save draft</button><output id="preview"></output></section>
